paragraphs: Minyamin, a Tanna of a baraita.

At the end of [Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sotah.1.2.7) they ask, “How long is the interval of seclusion?” After mentioning Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira and Rabbi Elazar, Hyman quotes Minyamin, “Enough time for her to extend her hand,” etc. Hyman associates the ruling with Chanin ben Pinchas in [Sotah 4a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.4a.4).

notes.text: In the linked Yerushalmi, Minyamin gives the time needed to reach into a basket for a loaf. In the linked Bavli, Peleimu gives that measure, while Chanin ben Pinchas gives the time needed to remove a splinter from the mouth. Hyman quotes only the words about extending the hand, which occur in both Bavli opinions.
